title: Arca1n's Pacifist Nightmare
description: Enjoy The Nightmare. The tables have turned
body:
Pacifist’s Nightmare

In this twisted survival mod, the rules of danger are reversed.

When night falls, hostile mobs become your potential friends. Zombies, skeletons, creepers, spiders, witches, blazes, phantoms, and more can be recruited, follow you around, help fight, and travel through portals with you.

But the peaceful world is no longer safe. Villagers, passive animals, and golems become nightmare bosses that hunt you down. Cows breathe fire. Villagers chase you. Golems become terrifying threats.

Your goal is to survive long enough to reach the End and tame the Ender Dragon. Once the dragon is tamed, the nightmare ends.

How To Tame Mobs

Zombie / Husk / Drowned: Bread
Skeleton / Stray: Calcite
Creeper: Sand
Spider: Red Mushroom
Enderman: Pumpkin
Witch: Glass Bottle
Blaze: Charcoal
Phantom: Clock

Features

Hostile mobs become friendly during the nightmare
Each recruited mob has a special ability
Friends follow you and travel through portals
Passive mobs, villagers, and golems become aggressive bosses
Fire-breathing cows
Nightmare starts at night or when a player sleeps
Nightmare ends when you tame the Ender Dragon

Can you survive a world where your enemies are your only friends?
